Source: https://github.com/linghe-yang/Secure-Distributed-Computing-Protocols.git
Commit: 79e905a8bcd6d3fc0a5423f8cfcb383ad33a919e
Original directory: util/

This is a narrow local Cargo patch of the shared utility crate. It does not copy
or replace WRBC, WRA, WGather, WBinAA or any other protocol implementation.
The root Cargo.toml [patch] applies it to every upstream primitive and to the
local encrypted transport wrappers. Upstream Node/config/types/crypto retain
their original git source and exact revision.

Changes:
- Enable TCP_NODELAY on accepted streams and on every outgoing connection,
  including reconnects.
- Encode the existing 4-byte little-endian length and authenticated frame into
  one buffer, then write_all once. No artificial batching delay is introduced.
- Preserve authentication, ACK MAC, per-peer sequence/deduplication, retries,
  independent peer queues, frame limits, and byte-for-byte wire format.
- Add framing, fragmented/coalesced reads, replay suppression, invalid and
  truncated ACK/reconnect, and silent-peer isolation regression tests.
- Replace relative sibling crate paths with pinned upstream git dependencies;
  use the workspace's Rust 1.99 / edition 2024 for this local patch.

io.rs and codec.rs are retained for upstream API compatibility.
No Cargo cache files or external repositories were modified.

Validation from repository root:
  cargo test -p util --locked
  cargo test --workspace --locked
  cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
  cargo fmt --all -- --check

A protocol requires dependent rounds; this patch removes avoidable TCP waiting
but does not reduce those rounds or the encoded protocol byte count. The root
benchmark continues to count actual TCP payload including application ACKs.
